name: The Phoenician
insider_take: Desert royalty meets contemporary luxury at this iconic Scottsdale landmark, where Hollywood glamour has captivated guests since 1988.
whats_special: The Phoenician sits on 250 acres of pristine Sonoran Desert at the base of Camelback Mountain, featuring a stunning mother-of-pearl pool that's been featured in countless films and magazines. The resort houses one of the world's largest collections of contemporary and classical art, including works by Dale Chihuly and original Frederic Remington sculptures.
pro_tip: Book the Afternoon Tea service - it's served in the resort's breathtaking Tea Court with panoramic views of the Valley, and the scones are legendary among Scottsdale locals.
dont_miss: The resort's Centre for Well-Being spa features a rooftop meditation garden with 360-degree desert views, and the nearby Camelback Mountain offers world-class hiking just minutes from your luxury suite. The Phoenician is also home to Arizona's only Forbes Five-Star spa.
pros: Iconic luxury resort with stunning Camelback Mountain views
World-class spa and championship golf course on-site
Expansive desert landscape with beautiful pools and gardens
cons: Large resort property requires walking or shuttle transportation
